main_text.p: cuius rei etiã illa Ciceronis, quę ex lib. de Off.II. subijciã, documento sunt: Quæ autē « opera,inquit,non largitione, « beneficia dantur,hæc tum in « uniuersam Rempublicã, tũ « in singulos ciues conferūtur. « nam in Iure cauere, consilio « iuuare, atque hoc scientię genere prodesse quãplurimis, « uehementer & ad opes augēdas « pertinet, & ad gratiā. « Itaque cùm multa præclara « maiorũ, tum quàm optimè « constituti Iuris ciuilis summo « semper in honore fuit co- « gnitio atque interpretatio: « quam quidē ante hanc con- « fusionem temporum in pos-

page.notes: The marks « in the right margin are printed quotation-continuation signs, one per line, transcribed as notes. Left-margin specks and marks are bleed-through or the neighbouring page edge and are omitted. The catchword "sef-" is read from its long-s form. "ge-nere" is printed without a visible hyphen, so it is written whole as "genere". The line-end "pos-" is printed with long s and is read as plain s.
